kind: shared capability extraction and original semantic mapping
implementation: crysirror-scene/layer/depth_order.rs; canonical client side-map, shared compare_primitives, no VM renderer/private float sort
rules: Finite depths only; order[0] major bucket remains primary.
Ordinary layers retain minor/owner/id/sub ordering and precede explicit depth scopes within same major.
Depth scopes sort depth then client then last committed rank. New scopes append in admission order.
Explicit group scope is inherited by payload descendants; nested scopes remain within parent scope. Cat native flat Z is mapped only to payloads.

frame(&self) computes pure keys; history mutates only on accepted owner frame. Intermediate SetDepth and None->Some updates do not change unseen order. None committed for a frame retires ordering admission.
Remove/clear purge side-map; clone/restore/transactions preserve and validate owner/id/admission/history.
Frozen subtree snapshots bake effective order into immutable LayerSpec.order before group-alpha isolation. Later live depths cannot change snapshot.
